P2 — Malfare expansion omits factor q — Counterevidence: Example's actual regret gap zero; q1 coefficient correct
P3 — Probability-sum weight estimator is inconsistent — Counterevidence: Log-likelihood is clearly intended; identical rewards allow optimal policies despite wrong weights

P5 — Reward-free displays have corrections within same paper — Counterevidence: Correct derivations/algorithm expressions already supplied; no implementation establishes wrong branch used
